stations.title: Ticket desk
stations.text: Charges what the fares code says.

captions: Ines says the ticket desk charged a family of four the full price.
The discount worked eight commits ago. Nobody knows which commit broke it.
You search the history, name the bad commit and fix it, in two tasks.
The group discount is back on main, and bike tickets still work.
A few tests found one commit among many. The fix sits on top.
